items.title: Shell (LSE:SHEL) Weighs U.S. Chemicals Exit As Industry Bidders Circle
items.summary: Shell (LSE:SHEL) is exploring a potential sale of its U.S. chemicals business, with ExxonMobil, LyondellBasell and other large industry players reported to have submitted offers. The move comes alongside recent portfolio sales in renewables and gas projects as Shell refines its asset mix and places greater emphasis on liquefied natural gas operations. items.title: America’s Strategic Petroleum Reserve Is Running on Fumes. What Happens When the Next Supply Shock Hits?
items.summary: The U.S. just used its emergency oil buffer to blunt a major supply shock, and it worked. But the strategy left America's strategic reserve at its lowest point in over four decades, and the next disruption could arrive before a single replacement barrel goes in the ground.
